author: masonproffitt
body:
#### PR description:

Adds a SONIC-based producer for MLPF. This producer is enabled by the modifier `MLPFSonicTriton`. The behavior of the existing MLPF producer is unchanged, but some of the shared logic of the two producers is factored out into common MLPF functions.

This PR depends on the following cms-data PR for the SONIC configuration files for the MLPF model: <https://github.com/cms-data/RecoParticleFlow-PFProducer/pull/6>

#### PR validation:

A runTheMatrix workflow offset of 1301 has been added that is identical to the standard MLPF offset of 13 apart from the replacement of `MLPFProducer` with `MLPFSONICProducer`. Based on the MLPF PR (#50316) a few months ago, the changes were tested with:

```
runTheMatrix.py -l 17034.1301 --what upgrade,standard,highstats,pileup,generator,extendedgen,production,ged,machine,premix
runTheMatrix.py -l 17043.1301 --what upgrade,standard,highstats,pileup,generator,extendedgen,production,ged,machine,premix
```

in addition to retesting the standard MLPF producer:

```
runTheMatrix.py -l 17034.13 --what upgrade,standard,highstats,pileup,generator,extendedgen,production,ged,machine,premix
runTheMatrix.py -l 17043.13 --what upgrade,standard,highstats,pileup,generator,extendedgen,production,ged,machine,premix
```
title: Add SONIC producer for MLPF
